nodes.name: Demo Lysosomal Storage Disorder A
nodes.description: Demonstration disease. Progressive multisystem disorder caused by deficiency of the demo enzyme LYSA1, leading to substrate accumulation in lysosomes.

nodes.name: Demo Neurodegeneration B
nodes.description: Demonstration disease. Childhood-onset neurodegeneration with ataxia and seizures, caused by loss of the demo lysosomal transporter LYSB2.

nodes.name: Demo Congenital Myopathy C
nodes.description: Demonstration disease. Early-onset muscle weakness with impaired autophagosome clearance, caused by variants in AUTC3.

nodes.name: Demo Retinal Dystrophy D
nodes.description: Demonstration disease. Progressive retinal degeneration caused by variants in the demo ciliary transport gene CILD4.

nodes.name: Demo Ciliopathy Syndrome E
nodes.description: Demonstration disease. Multisystem ciliopathy with polydactyly, retinal involvement, and renal cysts; caused by CILE5 or CILE6 variants.

nodes.name: Demo Metabolic Disorder F
nodes.description: Demonstration disease. Hepatic glycogen accumulation and fasting intolerance caused by variants in the demo gene GLYF7.

nodes.name: Demo Epileptic Encephalopathy G
nodes.description: Demonstration disease. Infantile-onset refractory epilepsy caused by variants in the demo synaptic vesicle gene SYNG8.

nodes.name: Demo Skeletal Dysplasia H
nodes.description: Demonstration disease. Short stature and skeletal anomalies caused by variants in SKEH9 or SKEH10; secondary autophagy involvement reported in one demo study.

edges.state: [DEMO-PUB-003, 2023] Demo fibroblast studies show LYSA1 and LYSB2 act sequentially: hydrolase products accumulate when LYSB2 export is lost, and both patient lines show the same demo storage signature. Phenotype overlap: developmental delay in both; ataxia and seizures specific to B.

edges.description: Retinal Dystrophy D and Ciliopathy E both disrupt the demo ciliary transport pathway.
edges.state: [DEMO-PUB-005/006] CILD4 (IFT) and CILE5 (basal body) act in the same demo transport module; both diseases share retinal degeneration and nystagmus.

edges.description: Myopathy C and Neurodegeneration B may share the impaired-clearance mechanism (autophagy converges on the lysosome).
edges.state: [Inference] AUTC3 fusion defects and LYSB2 export defects both produce accumulation of undegraded cargo, but in different tissues (muscle vs CNS) and with partial phenotype overlap (hypotonia only).

edges.description: A single demo study reported autophagy involvement in Skeletal Dysplasia H, suggesting overlap with Myopathy C.
edges.state: [Inference] One demo immunostaining study reported LC3 puncta in SKEH9 growth plate sections; no functional demo data; phenotype overlap limited to nonspecific short stature/weakness.

edges.description: Disorders A and F both show hepatomegaly and failure to thrive, and a legacy annotation places GLYF7 in the lysosomal pathway.
edges.state: [Inference] Shared phenotypes: hepatomegaly, failure to thrive. Legacy demo annotation links GLYF7 to lysosomal degradation. [DEMO-PUB-010, 2021] contradicts: GLYF7 is cytosolic; storage material in F is glycogen, not lysosomal substrate.

edges.description: Neurodegeneration B and Encephalopathy G share seizures and developmental delay.
edges.state: [Inference] Overlap is limited to high-prevalence phenotypes (seizures, developmental delay) that carry little information; the genes act in unrelated demo pathways (lysosomal export vs synaptic vesicle priming).

edges.description: Ciliopathy E and Skeletal Dysplasia H share short stature and polydactyly-adjacent skeletal findings.
edges.state: [Inference] Skeletal overlap exists but demo ciliary genes and growth plate genes act in different modules; one demo review speculates a link via ciliary signaling in chondrocytes.

edges.description: Disorder A and Myopathy C connect indirectly through lysosome-autophagy convergence.
edges.state: [Inference] Two-hop path: A disrupts lysosomal degradation; C blocks delivery into it. No direct demo co-study exists.

edges.description: Disorders F and H co-occur in one demo case report.
edges.state: [Inference] Single demo case report of co-occurrence; no mechanistic data; shared phenotype limited to short stature.

edges.description: Disorder B cohort shows retinal thinning on demo OCT, overlapping Retinal Dystrophy D's phenotype domain.
edges.state: [DEMO-PUB-007, 2024] 11/40 demo Disorder B patients showed retinal thinning; mechanism unknown; no shared pathway annotated between LYSB2 and CILD4.
